title: CosmoMail
brief: Priya needs a crisp, leadership-ready summary of the Atlas migration before Thursday's review. Use Cosmo to read the thread and answer questions (status, blockers, budget, timeline risk), then reply to Priya with a scannable bullet summary.

emails.subject: Atlas migration — weekly status
emails.body:
Team,

Kicking off the weekly status for the Atlas migration.

- **Scope:** move 12 services from the legacy cluster to Atlas.
- **Target go-live:** August 14.
- **Budget:** $85,000 approved; $22,000 spent to date.

Data layer is done. Sam owns the auth service; that's the current critical path.

Priya

emails.subject: Re: Atlas migration — weekly status
emails.body:
Update from me:

Auth service migration hit a blocker — the legacy tokens use a deprecated signing scheme Atlas doesn't support. I'm building a translation shim; ETA 5 business days.

This puts the auth service at risk of slipping past August 14. Everything else is on track. 7 of 12 services now migrated.

Sam

emails.subject: Re: Atlas migration — weekly status
emails.body:
Thanks Sam. Leadership is asking for a crisp summary before Thursday's review.

Can you pull together: where we are, what's blocked, the budget position, and whether August 14 still holds? Keep it to a few bullets they can scan.

Priya

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Help the learner interrogate the thread for facts (dates, owners, budget, blockers) and produce a concise, executive-ready summary. Encourage them to verify details against the emails.
assistant.initialMessage: Ask me anything about this thread — status, the blocker, budget, or whether Aug 14 still holds.

rubricHints.notes: Reward accurate use of thread facts: 7/12 services migrated, auth service blocked by a deprecated token signing scheme (Sam building a shim, ~5 business days), August 14 go-live at risk, budget $85k approved / $22k spent. Reward a scannable, bullet-form summary and effective use of Cosmo for Q&A. Penalize invented facts.
